name: ZCA_ORCH_DT_B
description: Contains the list of Orchestration objects.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier (Alternate Key) of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Language independent code for the current row of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: STRIPING_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Striping attribute name. The striping attribute name determines which orchestration process will be used.

columns.name: STRIPING_ATTR_DISPLAY_LABEL
columns.description: Striping attribute display label from the source object view definition.

columns.name: STRIPING_ATTR_VALUE
columns.description: Striping attribute value in JSON format.

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Specifies the lifecycle attr name.

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_ATTR_DISPLAY_LABEL
columns.description: Lifecycle attribute display label from the source object view definition.

columns.name: ASSOCIATION_CRITERIA_EXPR
columns.description: Criteria expression (in JSON format) used to associate Orchestration objects to transactional objects.

columns.name: SIMULATION_CRITERIA_EXPR
columns.description: Criteria expression (in JSON format) used to simulate Orchestration against transactional objects.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_JSON_STRUCTURE
columns.description: JSON structure for the whole Orchestration object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Orchestration object.Possible values are guided selling, guidance builder,etc.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the cloned source Orchestration when the current Orchestration row is cloned.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the Orchestration object. Possible values are DRAFT, ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, etc.

columns.name: ASSOCIATION_RANK
columns.description: Rank in which the Orchestrations need to be processed during association.

columns.name: ACTIVATION_DATETIME
columns.description: Date and timestamp on which the Orchestration is activated.

columns.name: IMPORTED_DATETIME
columns.description: Date and timestamp on which the Orchestration is last imported from a different env.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_RELATION_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Custom object's primary key field name on activity object for orchestration to stamp custom object id when activity is being generated.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
